description: Create a new sub account (IAM user). Use dryRun=true to preview without creating.

apiAllowSources.description: Allowed API access sources. Only applied when useApiAllowSource is true

source.description: Access source value — an IP address/range for type IP, or an instance number for VPC/VPC_SERVER

type.description: Access source type — IP: single IP or CIDR range, VPC: a VPC in use, VPC_SERVER: a server in a VPC

canAPIGatewayAccess.description: Whether to enable API Gateway access (creates access key)

consolePermitIps.description: Allowed console access IP ranges. Only applied when useConsolePermitIp is true

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without actually creating the sub account

loginId.description: Login ID (3-60 chars, English letters/numbers/special chars . @ - _, must start with letter)

needPasswordGenerate.description: If true, auto-generate password. If false, must provide password manually.

needPasswordReset.description: Whether to notify password change on first login

password.description: Login password (8-16 chars, required if needPasswordGenerate is false)

tags.description: Tags as a key-value map, max 20 per resource. Example: {"env":"dev","team":"a"}

useApiAllowSource.description: Restrict API access to specific sources. true: only apiAllowSources may call the API, false: any source

useConsolePermitIp.description: Restrict console access to specific IP ranges. true: only consolePermitIps may sign in, false: any IP

name: ncloud_create_sub_account
